custom = lambda values: 'custom'
[(any := custom) for _ in [0]]
assert any is custom
result = any([False, True])

custom = lambda values: 'custom'
[(all := custom) for _ in [0]]
assert all is custom

custom = lambda values: 'custom'
[[(any := custom) for _ in [0]] for _ in [0]]
assert any is custom

import builtins
[(any := 0) for _ in []]
assert any is builtins.any

import builtins
g = ((any := 0) for _ in [0])
assert any is builtins.any
result = any([False, True])

custom = lambda values: 'custom'
def f():
    global any
    [(any := custom) for _ in [0]]
f()
assert any is custom

[(lambda: (any := 0))() for _ in [0]]
assert any([False, True]) is True

def f():
    [(any := 0) for _ in [0]]
f()
assert any([False, True]) is True

[any for any in [0]]
